configSchema.title: LinkedIn OAuth
configSchema.description: Configure the LinkedIn app the workspace uses to connect member and organization accounts. Save its Client ID and Client secret here; users then connect their own LinkedIn account from the LinkedIn connector.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Client ID of your LinkedIn developer app.

fields.label: Client secret
fields.description: Write-only — leave blank to keep the saved secret.

fields.label: This app has the Community Management API (post to company pages)
fields.description: Turn this on only for an app whose one product is the Community Management API. Connecting then asks LinkedIn for company page permissions instead of sign-in permissions. After changing it, reconnect each LinkedIn account.

fields.label: Authorized redirect URI
fields.description: Register this exact URI in the LinkedIn developer app. It is derived automatically from the configured Nango server.

fields.label: Connection
fields.description: Checks whether both the Client ID and the Client secret are saved.

fields.label: About this connector
fields.whenReady: This page configures the shared LinkedIn app credentials the workspace uses to connect member and organization accounts. It is admin-level setup, not a personal connection. Once the credentials on the Setup tab are saved, users connect their own LinkedIn account from the LinkedIn connector.
fields.whenNotReady: This page configures the shared LinkedIn app credentials the workspace uses to connect member and organization accounts. It is admin-level setup, not a personal connection. Once the credentials on the Setup tab are saved, users connect their own LinkedIn account from the LinkedIn connector.

fields.label: Create a LinkedIn developer app
fields.whenReady: Create a LinkedIn developer app at linkedin.com/developers/apps (LinkedIn Developer Portal → Create app).
fields.whenNotReady: Create a LinkedIn developer app at linkedin.com/developers/apps (LinkedIn Developer Portal → Create app).

fields.label: Save the Client ID and secret
fields.whenReady: Copy the app's Client ID and Client secret onto the Setup tab and save. The secret is write-only — once saved it never round-trips back to the browser, so leave it blank on a later save to keep the stored value.
fields.whenNotReady: Copy the app's Client ID and Client secret onto the Setup tab and save. The secret is write-only — once saved it never round-trips back to the browser, so leave it blank on a later save to keep the stored value.

fields.label: Register the redirect URI
fields.whenReady: Register the exact Authorized redirect URI shown on the Setup tab in the LinkedIn app's OAuth settings. It must match exactly, or LinkedIn rejects the connection with a redirect_uri mismatch.
fields.whenNotReady: Register the exact Authorized redirect URI shown on the Setup tab in the LinkedIn app's OAuth settings. It must match exactly, or LinkedIn rejects the connection with a redirect_uri mismatch.
